title: Jude and the Clock
author: Sebastian Blackwood
blurb: Ulyana Blackwood, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
